start_frame: Toward one locked door of the east wall: her hand already on the large black iron handle, the mosaic dado and one blind roundel above it filling the rest of the frame.
end_frame: The same frame after she has hauled twice and given it up — the handle has not moved at all and her hand comes away.
constraint_honoured: 'Static — the first still frame since the reveal. We join the second pass already defeated.'
movement_note: The cut from a travelling shot onto a nailed-down close is what states the defeat; a move would keep the search alive when the scene needs it to have stopped.
